component.name: Arctic Launcher
component.summary: Play Minecraft and manage your instances, mods and worlds

description.p: Arctic Launcher is an open-source Minecraft launcher with support for multiple game versions, mod loaders, modpacks, skins and playing with friends.
Keep separate instances with their own mods and settings. Arctic downloads the Java runtime and game files each instance needs.
Arctic Launcher is not affiliated with Mojang Studios or Microsoft.
